result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but horizontally scrollable content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation sits very close to the system gesture area.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off at the right edge: part of an additional category pill is visible with no clear indication that the row can scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add intentional horizontal-scroll affordance (for example, a fade/chevron) and ensure the clipped next item has adequate edge spacing, or fit the categories within the viewport.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is heavily clipped, including its image, restaurant name, and delivery text, making the content look truncated rather than deliberately scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer carousel gutters/overflow treatment and provide a visible horizontal-scroll cue; alternatively adjust card widths so the visible partial card does not expose truncated text.

issues.description: The bottom navigation is positioned immediately above the gesture indicator with minimal safe-area separation, making the lower portion feel crowded.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom safe-area padding for the navigation bar so its labels and icons have more visual breathing room above the system gesture area.
